question: I got a traffic ticket. How do I pay it or contest it in court?

nuggets.text: Answer the notice of infraction by admitting, admitting with explanation or denying.
nuggets.quote: (a) (1) In answer to a notice of infraction, a person to whom the notice was issued may: (A) Admit, by payment of the civil fine and any related vehicle conveyance fee, the commission of the infraction;

Failure to answer the notice within this period shall result in the imposition of monetary penalties established by § 50-2301.05 , in addition to the potential civil fine for the infraction and any related vehicle conveyance fee.
